variables.meaning: restoring force; the minus sign in Hooke’s law says it points opposite to the displacement
applied force, equal and opposite to the restoring force while the system is deformed
force constant, the stiffness of the system; the slope of the force against displacement graph
elastic potential energy stored in a deformed system that obeys Hooke’s law
work done to deform the system; the area under the graph of applied force against deformation

glossary.definition: potential energy stored as a result of deformation of an elastic object, such as the stretching of a spring
a constant related to the rigidity of a system: the larger the force constant, the more rigid the system; the force constant is represented by k
force acting in opposition to the force caused by a deformation
